description.sub_ename: DESIGN ORIGINS: EXPLORING INTERIOR AND LIVING
description.describe_ch: 想了解室內設計如何改變生活，本課程以觀察、構想與創作為核心，帶領學生從零開始探索空間、材質與光的關係，體驗設計思考的魅力，為進入室內設計領域建立基礎。
description.describe_eh:
Would you like to explore how interior design changes people’s lives?
This course takes observation, conceptual thinking, and creation as its core elements, leading students to explore space, materials, and light.
Students will experience the attraction of design thinking in the field of interior design and establish foundational abilities for future learning in this discipline.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1.	準時上課並尊重師生互動。
2.	出席率將影響期末成績。
3.	課堂中需積極參與討論與活動。
4.	作業須於指定時間繳交，逾期酌扣分數。
Classroom Regulations
1.	Students are expected to arrive on time and show respect in teacher–student interactions.
2.	Attendance will affect the final grade.
3.	Active participation in class discussions and activities is required.
4.	Assignments must be submitted on time; late submissions will result in grade deductions.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Classroom Rules and Friendly Reminders

Please arrive on time and be prepared with all required materials.

Set your mobile phone to silent mode and avoid using it during class unless instructed.

Respect your classmates and the instructor; listen when others are speaking and avoid interrupting.

Keep the classroom clean and handle all equipment and materials with care.

During group discussions, participate actively and give everyone a chance to share their ideas.

If you need to leave early or miss a class, inform the instructor in advance when possible.

Feel free to ask questions at any time; there are no “stupid” questions in this class.

Be open-minded, supportive, and encourage one another’s learning and creativity.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
本課程強調學術誠信，嚴禁抄襲、代寫或未經授權之使用。所有報告與設計成果必須為學生原創，引用資料需標明出處。違反者將依校規處理，並影響學期成績。
This course emphasizes academic integrity. Plagiarism, ghostwriting, or unauthorized use of materials is strictly prohibited. All reports and design works must be the student’s original creation, and all references must be properly cited. Any violation will be handled in accordance with university regulations and will affect the final grade.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Students are expected to uphold the highest standards of academic integrity in all course activities. They must complete their own work honestly, accurately acknowledge the ideas and contributions of others through proper citation, and avoid all forms of plagiarism, fabrication, and cheating. Collaboration is only acceptable when explicitly permitted and must never misrepresent another person’s work as one’s own. Students should also respect intellectual property, maintain confidentiality where required, and report any serious violations they witness.
